events.artist: Blue Note Tokyo All-Star Jazz Orchestra directed by Eric Miyashiro
events.subtitle: with special guests Peter Erskine & Mike Mainieri
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents its All-Star Jazz Orchestra directed by Eric Miyashiro on August 17, 2026, with Peter Erskine and Mike Mainieri as special guests. Sets start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue explicitly links Erskine to Weather Report and Mainieri to Steps Ahead, and notes that Mainieri composed ‘Trains,’ which the orchestra and Erskine previously performed in a 2020 remote session.

provenance.note: Date, two set times, full orchestra lineup, special guests, Weather Report/Steps Ahead context and active web reservation status were verified on Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. Listening links are exact Apple Music album pages.

en.why_it_matters: This is a one-night convergence of two living fusion lineages with an unusually strong Japanese ensemble: Erskine brings the Weather Report drum language, Mainieri the vibraphone-centered Steps Ahead world, and Eric Miyashiro's orchestra adds players such as Masato Honda and Senri Kawaguchi. For Listening Notes, the appeal is less nostalgia than hearing those electric-jazz vocabularies refracted through a top-level Tokyo big band.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one of the two sets if you are in Tokyo; the one-night format, special guests and fusion lineage make it a destination night, though not a transpacific trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Es una convergencia de una sola noche entre dos linajes vivos de la fusión y una orquesta japonesa de altísimo nivel: Erskine trae el lenguaje de batería de Weather Report, Mainieri el mundo de Steps Ahead centrado en el vibráfono, y la orquesta de Eric Miyashiro suma instrumentistas como Masato Honda y Senri Kawaguchi. Para Listening Notes, el atractivo no es la nostalgia sino escuchar esos vocabularios del jazz eléctrico refractados por una gran banda de Tokio.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Hay que proteger uno de los dos sets si estás en Tokio; el formato de una sola noche, los invitados y el linaje de fusión lo vuelven una noche-destino, aunque por sí sola no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

events.factual_description: Tom Morello curates the one-day Power To The People Festival at Merriweather Post Pavilion in Columbia, Maryland on October 3, 2026. Merriweather lists gates at noon and a 1:00 PM show start, while the official festival site lists Foo Fighters, Dave Matthews, Tom Morello, Joan Baez, Public Enemy and a broad cross-genre bill with Bruce Springsteen as special guest. The venue describes the event as non-partisan and centered on music, art and community action.

recommended_listening.title: It Takes a Nation of Millions to Hold Us Back

provenance.note: Date, venue, 1:00 PM show time, one-day format, curator, lineup and civic framing were verified against Merriweather and the official festival site. The authorized ticket destination was verified on Live Nation. Listening links are exact Apple Music album pages.

en.why_it_matters: This is materially different from a routine festival stop: Morello has assembled an improbable one-day bill spanning Springsteen, Foo Fighters, Public Enemy, Joan Baez, Serj Tankian, Brittany Howard and more, in the DC/Baltimore orbit and with explicit civic context. For Listening Notes it connects DMV rock lineage, heavy guitar, hip-hop, folk protest traditions and multiple generations of live-performance culture in one unusually concentrated event.
en.trip_verdict: S+. Protect the date. The one-day-only lineup and DMV context make this worth a dedicated regional trip; it is the kind of culturally specific bill that is unlikely to recur in the same form.
en.listen_before: The Colour And The Shape; It Takes a Nation of Millions to Hold Us Back

es.why_it_matters: Esto es materialmente distinto de una parada rutinaria de festival: Morello reunió en un solo día un cartel improbable con Springsteen, Foo Fighters, Public Enemy, Joan Baez, Serj Tankian, Brittany Howard y más, dentro del corredor DC/Baltimore y con un contexto cívico explícito. Para Listening Notes conecta linaje rockero del DMV, guitarra pesada, hip-hop, tradición folk de protesta y varias generaciones de cultura de concierto en un evento excepcionalmente concentrado.
es.trip_verdict: S+. Hay que proteger la fecha. El cartel de una sola jornada y el contexto DMV justifican un viaje regional dedicado; es la clase de combinación culturalmente específica que difícilmente se repetirá de la misma manera.

events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Richard Bona Quintet on October 4-6, 2026. The October 4 sets start at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM; October 5-6 sets start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue describes Bona as returning with his own project after appearing with Mike Stern's band the previous year, emphasizing a quintet built to foreground his bass, groove and synthesis of African roots, jazz and fusion.

provenance.note: Three-night dates, differentiated set times, quintet lineup, groove/bass framing and web reservation status were verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. Listening links are exact Apple Music album pages.

en.why_it_matters: Bona is one of the rare bassists whose virtuosity, vocal phrasing and groove feel like one language rather than separate tricks. Blue Note Tokyo's framing is especially aligned with Listening Notes: a self-led quintet designed to put the bass forward, while his history with Zawinul, Pat Metheny and Sadao Watanabe places the set squarely at the intersection of fusion, African rhythmic identity and Japanese jazz connections.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. If you are in Tokyo, build a night around one of the six sets; Bona's instrumental identity and groove are strong enough to make this a destination club date, though not a transpacific trip on its own.
en.listen_before: Heritage; The Ten Shades of Blues

es.why_it_matters: Bona es uno de esos pocos bajistas cuya virtuosidad, fraseo vocal y groove suenan como un solo lenguaje y no como trucos separados. El planteamiento de Blue Note Tokyo encaja especialmente bien con Listening Notes: un quinteto propio diseñado para poner el bajo al frente, mientras su historia con Zawinul, Pat Metheny y Sadao Watanabe coloca el set justo en el cruce entre fusión, identidad rítmica africana y conexiones con el jazz japonés.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Si estás en Tokio, construye una noche alrededor de uno de los seis sets; la identidad instrumental y el groove de Bona alcanzan para volverlo una fecha-destino de club, aunque por sí sola no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.
es.listen_before: Heritage; The Ten Shades of Blues
